comparison.objective: Candidate rejects open cartons while allowing closed cartons through; PR-2158 opens a hanging combination padlock and leaves it hanging open.
comparison.physical_skill: Flap-aware grasping and spill-free conveyor removal versus precise multi-turn dial rotation with reversals, regrasping, and shackle pulling on a swinging body.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires correct classification/routing and stable tray placement without spill; PR-2158 requires aligned lock gates, opened shackle, release, rest, and no forced opening or dropped lock.
comparison.reason: Shared regrasping or moving-body control is generic; the tested abilities and terminal states do not overlap materially.
